description: Recorded paired camera estimates and accepted relative geometry during stationary-leader ACTIVE following. Coordinate matrices map controller bases into camera axes; 3x4 rows omit final [0,0,0,1]. Times are actual host monotonic times minus first ACTIVE control. Old acceptance is diagnostic, not input truth. No hardware command replay. Control goal is derived from each recorded relative base, with the initial leader TCP and relative target held fixed to isolate coordinate changes.
